pr_title: network: can: add support for CAN-FD related properties
pr_body:
This adds support for enabling the CAN-FD mode of CAN netdevs and setting the data phase bitrate and samplepoint. 

Closes #15219
pr_comments: @poettering & @ssahani: Should I change all the value checking and 32-bit type related stuff for the old CAN code as well? I might as well, cause that's where I copied the pattern from. If that's ok, I'll overhaul the CAN bitrate stuff a bit in general.

yes, clean-ups are always welcome. i.e. stay close to the kernel's own types for stuff, but use the right userspace types. i.e. __u32 usually means uint32_t in userspace, and so on. bools should be bools though, and tristates "int"s, and percentages/permilles `unsigned`s
I tested the patch on the `aarch64` platform with the MCP2517FD CAN-FD chip. It has the intended effect, so I removed the WIP flag.

issue_context.title: CAN-FD networking support in networkd
comments: Is there any documentation on how I would go about extending the parsers? Because otherwise it would be an incomplete PR.
From what I gather, I have to extend the gperf files?
yes it's very strate forward. Please see how other CAN variables are defined and do the same.
